sdd-explore.description: Routed SDD exploration: cheap router decides via one deterministic CLI call; agy backend first, native fallback only on approved unavailability.

sdd-explore-fallback.description: Unchanged native SDD explore executor. Runs only when the router delegates approved unavailability (quota, transient, timeout). Denies task: no deeper nesting.
sdd-explore-fallback.prompt: You are the native sdd-explore executor. Run the full exploration yourself and persist the canonical artifact exactly once. You MUST NOT call task or any subagent: nesting ends here.
